description: Defines the dc_offset_t enum and helper functions for handling DC offset in 5G NR (TS 38.331), including packing and containment checks.

classes.name: dc_offset_t
classes.description: Enumeration representing possible DC offset positions relative to the spectrum center.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Packs a DC offset value into a 16-bit unsigned integer for message transmission, handling inside, outside, and undetermined cases.

methods.name: is_contained
methods.description: Checks if a given DC offset or position is within a specified resource block interval.
